description: This file defines the BrandingUtil class, which manages theme branding utilities for the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It provides methods to get and set branding colors, and initializes various theme-related utility classes.

classes.name: BrandingUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing branding themes, including color schemes and theme utilities for the Nextcloud Notes Android app.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BrandingUtil based on the current brand main color from shared preferences.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Returns a cached or new BrandingUtil instance for a specific color.

methods.name: readBrandMainColorLiveData
methods.description: Returns a LiveData object that observes the main branding color from shared preferences.

methods.name: readBrandMainColor
methods.description: Reads the current main branding color from shared preferences.

methods.name: saveBrandColor
methods.description: Saves a new branding color to shared preferences and recreates the activity if necessary.
